profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at RentVision
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the computer software industry. Skilled in Javascript (including React), HTML, CSS, and Java with extended use of Linux systems. Strong engineering professional with a Bachelor of Science (B.S.) focused in Computer Science from University of Nebraska-Lincoln.

positions.title: Software Developer/Analyst
positions.description:
I am responsible for various software modifications and feature development for Nebraska University and State College
portals. This includes bug fixes as well. Development is primarily done in PeopleCode (Oracle’s PeopleSoft language),
along with relational database design.

Recent projects include:

Credentialing and Authentication System - I was in charge of creating a credentialing system that allowed for user registration and password recovery. This included password policy implementation, and credential security. Along with the credentialing system was the development of an authentication system for credential validation and user log in. Both systems included complementing web services.

PCI Compliant Password Policy System - I designed and built a system for creating password policies which allowed the Security team create custom password policies as needed. My design allowed for multiple policy creation to that could be separate groups of users. This included the ability to specify varying levels of severity to determine when passwords would need to be changed and how often email notifications would be sent to users.

Student Address Verification - Working with a third party service, this project enabled real time verification of student entered addresses. This helps save the Universities both time correcting invalid addresses, and money wasted on unsendable mail.

Automated Insurance Waiver Process - This projects purpose was to update the manual process of registering students for health insurance. Collaborating with the insurance waiver company, we automated the process, allowing students to quickly and efficiently recieve the coverage they need.

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
I am responsible for various software modifications and feature development for Nebraska University and State College
portals. This includes bug fixes as well. Development is primarily done in PeopleCode (Oracle’s PeopleSoft language),
along with relational database design. This position has been a great way to learn professional development practices,

positions.title: Student Worker - Computing Services Network
positions.description:
My key responsibilities included user support for various PC problems, as well as migration from and to PCs. My first
position related to the computing field, it was a good position to make connections, and I was able to quickly move
from this IT support position to my current position. My skills were readily recognized and I was recommended for
the newly opened internship.
